title: PaperCut NG MF: 2 flaws used in attacks; attackers can get in without a password
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 63 days old, so current versions are being attacked. Ready-made attack tools are public. The severity score is critical (9.4). The exploit prediction score is 85%.

category.label: Business software
category.why: It runs day-to-day business work such as finance, printing, phones or manufacturing.
category.doThis: Ask the vendor or the team that owns it whether the fix is in.

summary: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 14, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
